task.title: P6-002: Make same-type resource payloads echo their request and reject mismatches
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 3 — Leverage: fixes that retire a whole class). Original id: P6-002. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Make same-type resource payloads echo the request they answered, and have the consumer reject a mismatch and `refetch()`** (absorbs `P6-014`, which was the same defect filed twice by two review rounds). The cross-*shape* class is closed (named-field payloads plus `deny_unknown_fields`), but two resources of the *same* payload type can still swap payloads, and no discriminant or type tag helps because both sides pass it. Two live pairs confirmed 2026-07-30: `AllCardsPayload` is built in `AllCardsBody` (`all_cards.rs:169`) which **both** `/my` (`:130`) and `/my/all` (`:141`) mount, differing only by `?q=`; and `CollectionListPayload` (`catalog/destination.rs:339`) is consumed by both `destination.rs:317` and `my/move_selection.rs:566`. The "measured not to fire at today's id layout" and "~50 slots of headroom" claims are **unverified and layout-dependent** — `npm run diag:resource-ids` (`end2end/measure-resource-ids.mjs`, registered at `end2end/package.json:23`) is the tool that re-measures it and should be run first. The durable fix is upstream (`P6-013`); this closes the local hole in the meantime.
